name: 高频AI提示词｜日常工作学习教学

shortDescription: [[zh]]把写作、学习、教学和办公任务整理成可复用提示词[[/zh]][[en]]Turn common writing, learning, teaching, and office tasks into reusable prompt patterns for beginners who want less trial and error.[[/en]]
